title: 第7章 金丹九层很强吗第8章 谁家拿鸿蒙紫气炼魂幡
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
看到未来？
什么未来？
墨羽看到秦守的注意力一直在楚玉璃身上。
心中隐约有了猜测。
具体的，问一下就全知道了。
而且，邪修，人人得而诛之。
他最讨厌的便是邪修。
秦守悬停于半空，目光如狼似虎，肆无忌惮。
他嘴角勾起一抹邪笑，声音中带着毫不掩饰的贪婪。
“不得不说，长得可真漂……”
他话还未说完。
墨羽动了。
没有多余动作，没有祭出任何法宝。
只是随意抬起右手。
灵气瞬间喷涌而出，化为一只巨大的灵气手掌。
手掌遮天蔽日，散发着恐怖的威压。
仿佛能够将天地都握在掌中。
砰！
一声巨响。
以迅雷不及掩耳之势，将秦守牢牢抓住。

秦守甚至还没来得及反应，就被禁锢在半空中，动弹不得。
他脸上的狞笑瞬间僵住，取而代之的是无尽的惊骇。
怎么可能？！
他疯狂催动体内灵力，试图挣脱巨掌的束缚。
却发现一切都是徒劳。
那股力量浩瀚如渊，沉重如山。
压得他几乎窒息，五脏六腑仿佛都要被挤爆。
他惊恐地抬起头，看向墨羽。
这才发现，竟然完全看不透这人的修为。
该死！
这鬼地方怎么真有比他还强的修士？
墨羽自飞剑上一跃而下，稳稳落在地面。
“为什么要对我徒儿动手。”
秦守大惊。
“徒弟？怎么可能？她怎么可能有师父？”
content_en:
See the future?
What future?
Mo Yu saw that Qin Shou's attention had been on Chu Yuli.
There was a vague guess in my mind.
To be specific, just ask and you will know everything.
Moreover, evil cultivators will be punished by everyone.
What he hates most is evil cultivators.
Qin Shou was hovering in mid-air, his gaze was as unscrupulous as that of a wolf or a tiger.
There was a wicked smile on his lips, and there was undisguised greed in his voice.
"I have to say, she looks really pretty..."
He hasn't finished speaking yet.
Mo Yu moved.
There were no extra moves, no magic weapon was used.
Just raise your right hand casually.
The spiritual energy spurted out instantly and turned into a huge spiritual energy palm.
The palms covered the sky and the sun, exuding terrifying pressure.
As if he could hold the world in his hands.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
With lightning speed, Qin Shou was firmly captured.
Before Qin Shou could even react, he was imprisoned in mid-air and unable to move.
The ferocious smile on his face froze instantly, replaced by endless horror.
How is that possible? !
He frantically activated the spiritual power in his body, trying to break free from the shackles of the giant palm.
But found that everything was in vain.
That power is as vast as an abyss and as heavy as a mountain.
The pressure made him almost suffocate, and his internal organs seemed to be squeezed out.
He raised his head in horror and looked at Mo Yu.
Only then did he realize that he couldn't see through this man's cultivation at all.
Damn it!
How could there really be a monk stronger than him in this damn place?
Mo Yu jumped down from the flying sword and landed firmly on the ground.
"Why do you want to attack my disciple?"
Qin Shou was shocked.
"Apprentice? How is that possible? How can she have a master?"
